scenes.headline: Wrong 60% of the time, still profitable.
scenes.say: You can be wrong sixty percent of the time and still make money. Here's the math.

scenes.headline: Risk 1 to make 2.
scenes.say: Risk one unit to make two. That's a reward to risk of two to one.

scenes.title: Win rate you need to break even
head: Reward : risk
Break-even
scenes.say: At two to one you only need to win one trade in three to break even, before costs.

scenes.title: Win 40% at 2 : 1
scenes.say: Win four out of ten: plus eight R, minus six R. Plus two R every ten trades.

scenes.text: Follow for one trading concept a day.
scenes.say: Save this, and follow for one trading concept a day.

post.instagram:
With a 2:1 reward to risk you only need to win 1 trade in 3 to break even (33.3%, before costs). Win 4 out of 10: +8R − 6R = +2R every ten trades. Your win rate only means something next to your reward to risk.

Save this for later and follow @calmedgeofficial for one trading concept a day.
